body.intro: あの双子の猫娘が、日本語音声と日本語・英語字幕付きで登場! 淫らなカワイイ」の日本語音声は初公開です。
あなたは忙しい働き者ですが、とても寂しがり屋です。そんなあなたは、空っぽの家に新しい家族を迎え入れようと決意し、2匹の猫娘、ハナとカナを家政婦兼コンパニオンに迎えます。しかし、2匹の猫に発情期が訪れ、事態は急展開を迎える。
彼女は数分差で最年長です。物腰が柔らかく、とても働き者。

introductions.title: Cute Twin Catgirls In Heat [English Description]

body.intro:
The catgirl twins, now in Japanese audio with Japanese and English subtitles included! This is the first ever Japanese audio of Lewd Kawaii.

PLOT
You are a busy hardworking man, but you are also very lonely. You decide it's time to brighten up your empty house with new additions to the family, so you adopt two catgirls, Hana and Kana, to be your housemaids and companions. Things seem simple, but then the two cats go into heat and things take a sudden turn.

HANA
She is the oldest by a few minutes. She is soft spoken and a very hard worker.

KANA
She is the youngest and also the brattiest. Her attitude makes her ten times cuter.

Total content is 18 minutes.
